taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA-C (Gm-C) second-order low-pass biquad
* with exposed band-pass state and controlled common mode.
*
* Two-integrator loop:
*   Gm1: Vin -> Vbp          (band-pass state)
*   Gm2: Vbp -> Vlp          (low-pass output), ~2x Gm1
*   Gm3: Vlp -> Vbp (inv.)   (resonant feedback)
*   Rdamp across vbpp/vbpn   (sets Q; ideal R)
*   C1, C2 integration caps (half-circuit includes the 250 fF probe)
*   Two-stage CT-CMFB sets both state-pair common modes to vocm.

.subckt fd_ota vss vdd inp inn outp outn pcm
* Fully differential transconductor, non-inverting (Gm = G).
* Two source-degenerated PMOS common-source halves (no tail headroom needed).
* NMOS loads (pcm) set output common mode via CT-CMFB.
* Long-L devices for high output impedance.
RSP s1 vdd 12k
RSN s2 vdd 12k
XMP1 outn inp s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XMP2 outp inn s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XNL1 outp pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
XNL2 outn pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
.ends fd_ota

.subckt fd_ota_2x vss vdd inp inn outp outn pcm
* Same as fd_ota but ~2x gm (smaller source degeneration).
RSP s1 vdd 5k
RSN s2 vdd 5k
XMP1 outn inp s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XMP2 outp inn s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XNL1 outp pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
XNL2 outn pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
.ends fd_ota_2x

.subckt fd_ota_inv vss vdd inp inn outp outn pcm
* Inverting transconductor (Gm = G).
RSP s1 vdd 12k
RSN s2 vdd 12k
XMP1 outp inp s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XMP2 outn inn s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=30 nf=4
XNL1 outp pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
XNL2 outn pcm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
.ends fd_ota_inv

.subckt cmfb_amp vss vdd vocm cms out iref
* Stage 1: 5T OTA with floating output v1 (zero systematic offset).
* Stage 2: NMOS source follower drives out (pcm) from v1.
XMN1 vb cms tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=8 nf=2
XMN2 v1 vocm tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=8 nf=2
XNT tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
XMP1 vb vb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12 nf=2
XMP2 v1 vb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12 nf=2
C1 v1 vdd 0.2p
XSF vdd v1 out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=12 nf=4
XSFN out iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2.0 w=8 nf=2
.ends cmfb_amp

.subckt bias_gen vss iref vdd pbias
* iref receives 20 uA from the bench; diode NMOS to vss sets NMOS bias.
XND iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XNS pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XPD pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
.ends bias_gen

.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn

XBIAS vss iref vdd pbias bias_gen

* ---- Gm1: Vin -> Vbp (non-inverting), G ----
XG1 vss vdd vinp vinn vbpp vbpn pcm_bp fd_ota

* ---- Gm2: Vbp -> Vlp (non-inverting), ~2x G ----
XG2 vss vdd vbpp vbpn voutp voutn pcm_lp fd_ota_2x

* ---- Gm3: Vlp -> Vbp (inverting), G ----
XG3 vss vdd voutp voutn vbpp vbpn pcm_bp fd_ota_inv

* ---- integration caps ----
C1P vbpp vss 5.2p
C1N vbpn vss 5.2p
C2P voutp vss 5.2p
C2N voutn vss 5.2p

* ---- damping across band-pass pair (sets Q) ----
RD vbpp vbpn 22k

* ---- CMFB ----
RSP vbpp cms_bp 2MEG
RSN vbpn cms_bp 2MEG
RQP voutp cms_lp 2MEG
RQN voutn cms_lp 2MEG
XCMBP vss vdd vocm cms_bp pcm_bp iref cmfb_amp
XCMLP vss vdd vocm cms_lp pcm_lp iref cmfb_amp

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential active-RC second-order low-pass biquad with exposed band-pass state.
* Two-integrator loop:
*   C1*d(vbp)/dt  = vin/Rin - vout/Rf - vbp/Rd
*   C2*d(vout)/dt = vbp/R2
* LP = vout/vin, BP = vbp/vin.  CM held at vocm by FD op-amp CMFB.

* ---- fully differential two-stage Miller op-amp with CMFB ----
* pins: vss vdd inp inn outp outn vocm ibn ibp
.subckt fdop vss vdd inp inn outp outn vocm ibn ibp
* Stage 1: NMOS pair with diode-connected PMOS loads (d1p/d1n ~ 0.58V)
XMT sm ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
XMN1 d1p inp sm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 d1n inn sm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMPL1 d1p d1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
XMPL2 d1n d1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source with NMOS CMFB sinks
XMPS3 outp d1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
XMPS4 outn d1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=5
XMNS3 outp vcmo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=6
XMNS4 outn vcmo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=6
* Miller compensation
CC1 outp d1p 0.5p
CC2 outn d1n 0.5p
* CMFB: sense output CM vs vocm, drive NMOS sink gates (vcmo)
RSP outp vsns 200k
RSN outn vsns 200k
XCM1 cd1 vsns csc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XCM2 vcmo vocm csc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=4
XCM3 cd1 cd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
XCM4 vcmo cd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=4
XCM5 csc ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=2
.ends fdop

* ---- biquad ----
.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
* bias: 20uA forced into iref -> NMOS diode
XNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=14 nf=7
* PMOS diode: NMOS sink (gate=iref, W/L=7 -> 20uA)
XPN ibp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=14 nf=7
XPB ibp ibp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=32 nf=16

* ---- int1: summing inverting integrator -> vbp ----
XR1 vss vdd x1p x1n vbpp vbpn vocm iref ibp fdop
C1P vbpp x1p 2p
C1N vbpn x1n 2p
RIN1P vinn x1p 59.8k
RIN1N vinp x1n 59.8k
RFP1 voutp x1p 59.8k
RFN1 voutn x1n 59.8k
RDP1 vbpp x1p 28.1k
RDN1 vbpn x1n 28.1k

* ---- int2: non-inverting integrator -> vout (cross-coupled inputs) ----
XR2 vss vdd x2p x2n voutp voutn vocm iref ibp fdop
C2P voutp x2p 2p
C2N voutn x2n 2p
R2P vbpn x2p 26.5k
R2N vbpp x2n 26.5k

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA-C biquad (low-pass + band-pass states, CM controlled)
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
* Only MOS devices, ideal R and ideal C are used.

.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn

*---------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias: 20 uA is forced into iref externally.  A diode-connected
* device sets a bias voltage; current mirrors copy fixed ratios
* of that current at every corner.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XBN ibn ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

* PMOS load bias reference (fixed current from vdd)
XPB pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMB pbias ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------
* OTA1: summing transconductor, input = (vinp-vinn) - (voutp-voutn)
* Two source-degenerated input pairs with a fixed tail current
* share the BP output nodes.
* Pair A: vinp/vinn -> vbpp/vbpn
* Pair B: voutn/voutp -> vbpn/vbpp  (negative feedback of LP state)
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XTT1 t1 ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
RT1 t1 vss 1meg   ; 20 uA tail

XM1 vbpp vinp s1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XM2 vbpn vinn s2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XM3 vbpn voutn s3a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XM4 vbpp voutp s4a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
RS1 s1a t1 36k
RS2 s2a t1 36k
RS3 s3a t1 36k
RS4 s4a t1 36k
* Load current = pair current (10 uA/node) + CMFB sink (~5 uA)
XP1 vbpp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP2 vbpn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
CC1 vbpp vss 1000f
CC1n vbpn vss 1000f
RL1 vbpp vbpn 150k

* CMFB for the BP pair: resistor-loaded diff pair (scm vs vocm),
* inverter, NMOS current sinks at the outputs.
RSC1a vbpp scm1 100k
RSC1b vbpn scm1 100k
XN1 x1 scm1 s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XN2 y1 vocm s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XET1 s1 ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.125 nf=1 ; 15 uA tail
RX1 x1 vdd 100k
RY1 y1 vdd 100k
XMZ z1 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XPL z1 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1   ; fixed 5 uA
XJ1 vbpp z1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XJ2 vbpn z1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1

*---------------------------------------------------------------
* OTA2: source-degenerated input pair, input = vbpp/vbpn,
* output = LP state
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XTT2 t2 ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75 nf=1  ; 10 uA tail
RT2 t2 vss 1meg

XM5 voutp vbpp s5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XM6 voutn vbpn s6 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
RS5 s5 t2 36k
RS6 s6 t2 36k
XP5 voutp pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XP6 voutn pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
CC2 voutp vss 450f
CC2n voutn vss 450f

* CMFB for the LP pair
RSC2a voutp scm2 100k
RSC2b voutn scm2 100k
XN7 x2 scm2 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XN8 y2 vocm s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XET2 s2 ibn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.125 nf=1 ; 15 uA tail
RX2 x2 vdd 100k
RY2 y2 vdd 100k
XMZ2 z2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XPL2 z2 pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XJ3 voutp z2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
XJ4 voutn z2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA-C biquad: 2nd-order LP + exposed band-pass state, CM controlled
.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
* OTA-A output = band-pass state; OTA-B output = low-pass state.
* OTA-A input sums: vin - vout(lp) - 2*vbp(damping)  -> Q=1/sqrt2, BP peak=-6 dB
* Bias: iref (20 uA) -> vbn; vbp from PMOS diode loop with startup resistor.
*.param rs1=56k rs2=28k cint=1.7p

* ---------- global bias from iref (20 uA forced into iref from vdd) ----------
XREF   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* vbp: PMOS diode loop, diode current sunk by NMOS mirror of iref
XPB    vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XMBPIAS vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
RSTART vbp vdd 1meg

* ---------- OTA-A: output = band-pass state (vbpp/vbpn) ----------
X11P vbpp vinp s11p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
X11N vbpn vinn s11n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
RS1P s11p t1a 56k
RS1N s11n t1a 56k
XT1A t1a iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=3
X21P vbpp voutn s21p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
X21N vbpn voutp s22n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
RS2P s21p t2a 56k
RS2N s22n t2a 56k
XT2A t2a iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=3
X31P vbpp vbpn s31p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
X31N vbpn vbpp s32n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
RS3P s31p t3a 28k
RS3N s32n t3a 28k
XT3A t3a iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=3
XPLA vbpp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XPLB vbpn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XSNA vbpp eaoa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XSNB vbpn eaoa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
RCSA vbpp cmsa 100meg
RCSB vbpn cmsa 100meg
XEA1 xa cmsa easa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XEXA xa vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XEA2 eaoa vocm easa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential second-order OTA-C biquad (Tow-Thomas), Sky130.
* OTA_A sums the input and the crossed LP feedback into the band-pass state;
* OTA_B integrates BP into the low-pass state. Damping resistor sits across
* the BP differential pair so BP is a true band-pass (transmission zero
* at DC):
*   w0 = sqrt(GmA*GmB/(C1*C2)),  Q = w0*Rd*C1,  BP peak gain = GmA*Rd.
* All Gm stages use resistively degenerated NMOS input pairs so that
* Gm ~ 1/Rdeg for gm*Rdeg >> 1 (PVT-stable, linear). Each OTA has a local
* CMFB (resistor-averaged output sense vs vocm) driving its PMOS load gates.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- CMFB amp
* Two-stage Miller. out rises when inn rises relative to inp. Tail gate is
* nbias_c (~1.2 V); the stage-2 sink is gated from nbias_a (~0.6 V).
.subckt cmfb_amp vdd vss nbc nba inp inn out
Xt  nt  nbc   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2 nf=2
X1  n1  inp   nt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
X2  n2  inn   nt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
X3  n1  n1    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
X4  n2  n1    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=2
X5  out n2    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4 nf=2
X6  out nba   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=5 nf=2
Ccc out n2    300f
.ends cmfb_amp

* ------------------------------------------------------ OTA_A (BP summer)
* Two degenerated NMOS input pairs summing into shared drains: gates
* inp/inn (signal) and fbp/fbn (crossed LP feedback). NMOS cascodes lift
* the outputs; cascode-free PMOS loads are driven by the local CMFB.
.subckt ota_sum vdd vss nbc nba nbias_c nbias_t inp inn fbp fbn outp outn vocm
X1a fp inp  spa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
X2a fn inn  sna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
X1b fp fbp  spb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
X2b fn fbn  snb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Rda1 spa ta 15k
Rda2 sna ta 15k
Rdb1 spb tb 15k
Rdb2 snb tb 15k
Xta ta nbias_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Xtb tb nbias_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Xca outp nbias_c fp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
Xcb outn nbias_c fn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=2
Xla outp pga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=30 nf=5
Xlb outn pga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=30 nf=5
Rsa outp cma 100k
Rsb outn cma 100k
Csa cma vss 200f
Xea vdd vss nbc nba vocm cma pga cmfb_amp
.ends ota_sum

* -------------------------------------------- OTA_B (LP integrator)
* Single degenerated NMOS input pair, same output stage style.
.subckt ota_int vdd vss nbc nba nbias_c nbias_t inp inn outp outn vocm
X1p fxp inp sp1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
X2p fxn inn sp2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Rdg1 sp1 tl 15k
Rdg2 sp2 tl 15k
Xtl tl nbias_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
Xca outp nbias_c fxp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
Xcb outn nbias_c fxn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
Xla outp pgb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
Xlb outn pgb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=4
Rsa outp cmb 100k
Rsb outn cmb 100k
Csa cmb vss 200f
Xea vdd vss nbc nba vocm cmb pgb cmfb_amp
.ends ota_int

* ------------------------------------------------------------- bias ladder
* The iref pin node is the bench-driven diode-connected NMOS (20 uA).
.subckt bias_gen vdd vss iref nbias_t nbias_c nbias_a
* iref diode: master NMOS gate reference (~0.65 V at 20 uA)
Xref  iref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* PMOS mirror master: nref branch copies iref, PMOS diode sets mirror gate
Xnref nref  iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
Xmpr  nref  nref  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* nbias_t: 30 uA through a diode matched to the OTA tail devices
Xmpt  nbias_t nref  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36 nf=6
Xnt   nbias_t nbias_t vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* nbias_c: cascode gate bias ~1.15 V = diode Vgs + resistor drop (keeps the
* NMOS cascodes in saturation with outputs at 0.9 V);
* nbias_a: diode tap (~0.68 V) for the CMFB amp stage-2 sinks
Xmpc  nbias_c nref  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=12 nf=4
Rbc   nbias_c nbias_a 47k
Xc2   nbias_a nbias_a vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
.ends bias_gen

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- top level
.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
XBIAS vdd vss iref nbias_t nbias_c nbias_a bias_gen
* NMOS pairs invert, and OTA_B inverts again; cross the LP feedback so the
* loop is negative.
XOTA_A vdd vss nbias_c nbias_a nbias_c nbias_t vinp vinn voutn voutp vbpp vbpn vocm ota_sum
C1p vbpp vss 5.6p
C1n vbpn vss 5.6p
XOTA_B vdd vss nbias_c nbias_a nbias_c nbias_t vbpp vbpn voutp voutn vocm ota_int
C2p voutp vss 2.75p
C2n voutn vss 2.75p
RDAMP vbpp vbpn 10k
.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential active-RC biquad: lossy integrator -> band-pass state,
* pure integrator -> low-pass state. Poles/zeros/Q set by ideal R and C
* (PVT-stable); MOS op-amps provide gain. Per-op-amp CM feedback via
* output current injection holds both state pairs at vocm.
* Bias currents are self-biased (degenerated pairs) referenced to the
* forced 20 uA iref sink.

.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Global bias: sink for the forced 20 uA iref current.               *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* U1: lossy integrator, output = band-pass state (vbpp/vbpn)         *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XOP1 vss vdd vocm s1p s1m vbpp vbpn fd_ota_c_biquad_opamp
RINP vinp s1p 170k
RINN vinn s1n 170k
R2P vbpn s1p 170k
R2N vbp s1n 170k
CF1P vbpp s1p 700f
CF1N vbpn s1n 700f
RP1 vbpp vss 80k
RP2 vbpn vss 80k

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* U2: pure integrator, output = low-pass state (voutp/voutn)        *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
XOP2 vss vdd vocm s2p s2m voutp voutn fd_ota_c_biquad_opamp
RAP vbp s2p 40k
RAN vbpn s2n 40k
CF2P voutp s2p 700f
CF2N voutn s2n 700f

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Fully differential op-amp. ip biased to vocm externally; im is the *
* virtual-ground summing node. Self-biased NMOS input pair (tail R   *
* to vss), simple PMOS mirror load. CM feedback injects current at   *
* both output nodes under control of a sense amp comparing the       *
* output-pair common mode to vocm.                                   *
*--------------------------------------------------------------------*
.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad_opamp vss vdd vocm ip im outp outn
* Self-biased input pair tail: resistor to vss (~40 uA total).
XTAIL vsig vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
RT vsig vss 12k
* Input differential pair, bulk tied to source (no body effect).
XMP outn ip vsig vsig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN outp im vsig vsig sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* Simple PMOS current-mirror load.
XMLP outn outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3
XMLN outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=3

* DC path for the non-inverting input (gate-only node).
RIP ip vocm 1meg

* Common-mode sense node for this op-amp's output pair.
RCSP outp csp 100k
RCSN outn csp 100k

* Sense amplifier. Output ead1 = Verr is DC-defined by the diode load.
XEE1 ead1 vocm ees ees sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XEE2 ead2 csp ees ees sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XEETAIL ees vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
RETEE ees vss 62k
XEEL1 ead1 ead1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XEEL2 ead2 ead1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* CM current injection at both output nodes, both gates driven by Verr.
XINJPp outp ead1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINJPn outn ead1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINJPpP outp ead1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XINJPnP outn ead1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad_opamp

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential OTA-C second-order low-pass biquad with exposed
* band-pass state and continuous-time CMFB for both state pairs.
*
* Tow-Thomas loop (differential signals, C1 = C2 = C):
*   s*C*Vbp = GmA*(Vin + Vlp) - 2*Vbp/Rd
*   s*C*Vlp = -GmB*Vbp
* LP gain = GmAin/GmAfb = 1 (input and feedback pairs are matched halves
* of one 4-gate OTA, which also cancels their odd-order distortion since
* Vlp ~ -Vin in the passband).
* f0 = sqrt(GmAfb*GmB)/C, Q = w0*C*Rd/2, BP peak = GmAin*Rd/2 ~ -6.5 dB.
* Signal OTAs are moderate-inversion diff pairs with ideal-R source
* degeneration so Gm ~ 1/(2Rs) stays PVT-stable.  The forced iref = 20 uA
* biases all tails/sinks through diode master XMBP/XMBN.
*
* CMFB per pair: 300k resistive divider senses the pair CM; an NMOS diff
* pair compares it with vocm (diode-loaded, low-Z inverting output); a
* low-impedance inverting second stage drives push-pull correctors
* (NMOS sinks + PMOS sources, gates both on the control node) so the CM
* can be pushed both ways.  The state capacitors dominate the loop pole,
* keeping the CM loop first-order-like and fast.

.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn

* ---------------- Bias master ----------------
* PMOS diode (vdd->iref) + NMOS diode (iref->vss) sink the forced 20 uA;
* the iref node gates every NMOS tail/current sink in the design.
XMBP iref iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=4
XMBN iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- OTA_A positive half (drives vbpp) ----------------
* Merged input pair (vinp/vinn) and feedback pair (voutp/voutn):
* i(vbpp) = GmA*((vinp-vinn) + (voutp-voutn)).
XM1A nal vinp nas1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA1 nas1 ta 34k
XM2A vbpp vinn nas2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA2 nas2 ta 34k
XM3A nal voutp nas3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA3 nas3 ta 36k
XM4A vbpp voutn nas4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA4 nas4 ta 36k
XMLA1 nal nal vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMLA2 vbpp nal vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMTA ta iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- OTA_A negative half (drives vbpn) ----------------
XM5A nnl vinn nbs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA5 nbs1 tn 34k
XM6A vbpn vinp nbs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA6 nbs2 tn 34k
XM7A nnl voutn nbs3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA7 nbs3 tn 36k
XM8A vbpn voutp nbs4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RA8 nbs4 tn 36k
XMLA3 nnl nnl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMLA4 vbpn nnl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMTN tn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- OTA_B positive half (drives voutp, inverting) ----------
* Gates crossed vs OTA_A so that s*C*Vlp = -GmB*Vbp.
XM1B nbl vbpn ncs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RB1 ncs1 tb 15k
XM2B voutp vbpp ncs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RB2 ncs2 tb 15k
XMLB1 nbl nbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMLB2 voutp nbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMTB tb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- OTA_B negative half (drives voutn) ----------------
XM3B nnr vbpp nds1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RB3 nds1 td 15k
XM4B voutn vbpn nds2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
RB4 nds2 td 15k
XMLB3 nnr nnr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMLB4 voutn nnr vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMTD td iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- Integrating capacitors and Q-setting damper -------
CBP1 vbpp vss 4.5p
CBP2 vbpn vss 4.5p
CLP1 voutp vss 4.5p
CLP2 voutn vss 4.5p
RD vbpp vbpn 25k

* ---------------- CMFB, low-pass pair ----------------
* Single-stage CMFB.  NMOS sense pair (M1N gate = ncml on the diode
* side, M2N gate = vocm) with PMOS current-mirror load; the mirror
* output ecl drives push-pull correctors (NMOS sinks + PMOS sources)
* directly.  ncml rising raises ecl (i1 mirrored into ecl rises),
* turning sinks on harder and sources off -> negative feedback on the
* pair CM.  Balance is i1 = i2, i.e. ncml = vocm, independent of the
* tail current; a 5 meg keeper prevents the floating-control latch at
* startup.  The CM loop has one dominant pole (the state capacitors).
RSL1 voutp ncml 470k
RSL2 voutn ncml 470k
XMTLN epl iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMCL1N d1l ncml epl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2.3 nf=2
XMCL2N ecl vocm epl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2.3 nf=2
XMPLP d1l d1l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XMPLQ ecl d1l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2
RKPL ecl vdd 5meg
XSKL1 voutp ecl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XSKL2 voutn ecl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XSRL1 voutp ecl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2 nf=2
XSRL2 voutn ecl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2 nf=2

* ---------------- CMFB, band-pass pair ----------------
RSB1 vbpp ncmb 470k
RSB2 vbpn ncmb 470k
XMTBN epb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMCB1N d1b ncmb epb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2.3 nf=2
XMCB2N ecb vocm epb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2.3 nf=2
XMBPP d1b d1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XMBPQ ecb d1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2
RKPB ecb vdd 5meg
XSKB1 vbpp ecb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XSKB2 vbpn ecb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.84 nf=2
XSRB1 vbpp ecb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2 nf=2
XSRB2 vbpn ecb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=2 nf=2

.ends fd_ota_c_biquad

taskTitle: Design a Fully Differential OTA-C Biquad
circuit:
* Fully differential second-order Tow-Thomas active-RC (OTA-C) biquad.
* Low-pass state on voutp/voutn, band-pass state tapped on vbpp/vbpn.
* Two Miller-compensated fully differential OTAs with cascoded outputs,
* resistor integrator/damping network, and one CMFB loop per state node.

* ---------------- OTA: two-stage, fully differential, cascoded output ----
* pins: vdd vss inp inn outp outn pbp(stage1 load gate) bnc(n cascode gate)
*       bpc(p cascode gate) tg(tail gate = CMFB output)
.subckt fd_ota vdd vss inp inn outp outn pbp bnc bpc tg
* stage 1: NMOS diff pair with PMOS current-source loads
XM1 d1 inp t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
XM2 d2 inn t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=2
XMT t1 tg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.65 nf=2
XML1 d1 pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
XML2 d2 pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
* level shifters so the stage-2 PMOS gates sit ~0.6 V above d1/d2
XLS1 vss d1 pg1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.75 nf=4
XLS2 vss d2 pg2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.75 nf=4
RPG1 pg1 vdd 220k
RPG2 pg2 vdd 220k
* stage 2: outp driven from d2, outn driven from d1 (inverting)
XMN2 ncp d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=2
XMNC outp bnc ncp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=4
XMP2 pcp pg2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.4 nf=2
XMPC outp bpc pcp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.4 nf=2
XMN2B ncn d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=2
XMNCB outn bnc ncn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=4
XMP2B pcn pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.4 nf=2
XMPCB outn bpc pcn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.4 nf=2
* Miller compensation
CCP outp d2 200f
CCN outn d1 200f
.ends fd_ota

* ---------------- CMFB: senses state CM, drives OTA tail gate ------------
* pins: vdd vss ocm(state CM sense) vocm(reference) cmout pbp cmref
.subckt fd_cmfb vdd vss ocm vocm cmout pbp cmref
XMP1 nc1 vocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.3 nf=2
XMM1 cmout ocm tcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.3 nf=2
XMT tcm cmref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.65 nf=2
XLP1 nc1 nc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.3 nf=2
XLP2 cmout nc1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.3 nf=2
RCM cmout vss 200k
CCOMP cmout vss 60p
CACC nc1 vocm 500f
.ends fd_cmfb

* ---------------- bias generator from iref (bench forces 20u) ------------
* pins: vdd vss iref pbn pbp bnc bpc cmref
.subckt bq_bias vdd vss iref pbn pbp bnc bpc cmref
* Mb1 sinks the bench 20u plus 10u through RBT
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=4
RBT pbn iref 25k
XMBP pbn pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
* branch 2: pbp mirror reference at 10u
XMB2N nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XMB2P nb2 nb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
* branch 3: bnc = diode drop + resistor level shift (~0.78 V)
XMB3P nb3 pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
RBNB nb3 nb4 23k
XMB3A nb4 nb4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=4
* branch 4: bpc = vdd - |Vgs| (~0.7 V drop)
XMB4N nb5 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
XMB4A nb5 nb5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.8 nf=2
* cmref: raised diode reference (~0.95 V) for the CMFB pair tail
XMB5P cmref pbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5.5 nf=6
RCMR cmref cmrefd 30k
XMB5N cmrefd cmrefd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends bq_bias

* ---------------- top-level biquad ----------------------------------------
.subckt fd_ota_c_biquad vss iref vdd vinp vinn vocm vbpp vbpn voutp voutn
* integrator A1 -> band-pass state (bpp/bpn)
R1A vinp sp 200k
R1N vinn sn 200k
R3A voutn sp 200k
R3N voutp sn 200k
R4A bpp sp 133k
R4N bpn sn 133k
C1A bpp sp 100f
C1N bpn sn 100f
XA1 vdd vss sp sn bpp bpn pbp bnc bpc cm1 fd_ota
* integrator A2 -> low-pass state (voutp/voutn)
R2A bpp sp2 200k
R2N bpn sn2 200k
C2A voutp sp2 100f
C2N voutn sn2 100f
XA2 vdd vss sp2 sn2 voutp voutn pbp bnc bpc cm2 fd_ota
* band-pass expose divider (scaled tap, k ~ 0.68)
RDA bpp vbpp 10k
RDN bpn vbpn 10k
RDB vbpp vbpn 42k
* common-mode sense dividers
RD1 bpp ocm1 200k
RD2 bpn ocm1 200k
RU1 voutp ocm2 200k
RU2 voutn ocm2 200k
